non_negotiable_submission_disclosures: DeepDRiD suffix-to-anatomy mapping remains unresolved; both branches are reported.
Historical test partition is exposed and not used for confirmatory claims.
Risk is empirically selected and uncertified; bootstrap intervals are wide.
MFIDDR-only four-field and non-myopic CCG claims are excluded.
Current manuscript is not ready for arXiv or IEEE submission.
reason: The project is being rebuilt to exceed an MFIDDR-style dataset benchmark by adding risk-controlled sequential acquisition, external robustness, failure analysis, and clinical cost-risk-defer evaluation. Current evidence remains development-only.
required_before_arxiv: Resolve or explicitly stabilize the suffix-to-anatomy limitation
Expand related work across active acquisition, selective prediction, multi-view DR grading, and DR screening
Complete or remove pending secondary analyses
required_before_ieee_journal: Clean unexposed paired/multi-field test or independent external validation
Stronger acquisition, selective-classification, and encoder comparator experiments
Detailed model, protocol, and clinical workflow reporting
Broad reference list and failure analysis
scope: Internal DeepDRiD paired-view development artifact under ActiveRetina Flagship Rebuild V2; not a public preprint or journal submission.
stronger_than_mfiddr_definition: Stronger means decision-theoretic clinical acquisition evidence beyond a dataset benchmark, not pretending to have MFIDDR-scale four-field data.
